paidOutFormula: revenue 943,638,406 − operating cash flow 272,399,022 + capex 130,817,440 + interest paid in financing 32,325,287 (MXN thousands, as stated)
notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (FY2025 Form 20-F). IFRS filer that classifies interest paid in financing, so it is added back (32,325,287); income taxes paid are in operating. Lease payments (51,585,889, "Payment of liability related to right-of-use of assets") are in financing. Interest expense on lease liabilities was 16,156,752 in 2025 (lease note), but the 20-F does not say whether the cash paid for it sits in "Interest paid" or in the right-of-use payment line, so nothing more is added; if it is in the latter, paidOut is understated by up to about 2%. Interest received (2,504,220) sits in operating; dividends received are in investing. The USD column in the 20-F is a convenience translation and is not used; FX: calendar-2025 average. The new-year ifrs-full facts are not yet in SEC companyfacts, so no xbrl objects are given.
